name: Hückeswagen (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city arms of Hückeswagen (a red castle above a red lion and a black bowl on white).
history: Municipal flag of Hückeswagen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hückeswagen arms — castle, lion and bowl
